d:
Türkiye pulled off one of the CRAZIEST finishes of the 2014 FIBA Basketball World Cup in a Round of 16 showdown against Australia!
With just over a minute left, Australia led 64-59 and looked ready to advance. Then Emir Preldzic happened!
Preldzic knocked down TWO clutch three-pointers in the final 48 seconds, including the game-winner with just 5 seconds remaining, to turn a five-point deficit into a stunning 65-64 victory!
Preldzic and Sinan Guler led Türkiye with 16 points each, as the team pulled off an incredible comeback to eliminate Australia and book a spot in the quarterfinals.
